BillingReconciliation.description: Boards 10.2 and 10.3. **The first invoice sets the tone for the relationship.**

CommercialMetric.description: One commercial figure. Money-valued codes carry a `Money`; counts, rates and days a number (naming-and-style 5.1: money is never a float).

groupKey.description: The band, profile or model this row is for, on a code split by one; null otherwise.

CommercialMetricSet.description: The commercial command centres' figures, one row per metric code (getCommercialMetrics).

tenantId.description: The customer the figures are for; null for the whole portfolio.

Money.description:
**On the wire this is three fields; in the database it is one column.**
24 August. Every column typed `Money` was landing as `jsonb` — 129 of them, including `orders.shift.opening_float`, `inventory.purchase_order.total` and `promotions.voucher.balance`. **`orders.cash_movement.amount` was `numeric(18,4)` because somebody hand-typed that one**, and the inconsistency is what made it visible.
**A jsonb price cannot be summed in SQL.** Every total, variance and reconciliation moves into application code — and a shift variance computed in .NET against a ledger computed in Postgres is two answers to one question. That is F13 month-end and F98 takings-to-ledger, both walked, both assuming the arithmetic is in the database.
**`currency` and `scale` are not stored per row.** ADR-0018 makes them region-scoped and not overridable below, so they resolve from the scope walk — storing AED against nine million rows in a UAE region is nine million copies of a fact that cannot differ. A row that needed its own currency would be a row in the wrong region.
**They stay on the wire** because a client reading a figure should not have to walk a hierarchy to know what it means.

amount.description: Decimal string, never a float. Up to 4 decimal places. **Persisted as `numeric(18,4)`** — the string is a transport choice, so a JavaScript client cannot round a fare in transit.

currency.description: **Resolved from the region, not stored on the row** (ADR-0018). OMR uses 3 decimal places and AED uses 2 — a venue on a different scale from its region is a ledger that cannot consolidate.

PackageSimulation.description: Boards 3.9 and 4.8. **Refused at quote time rather than at go-live.**

scheduledChange.description: A downgrade waiting for the next renewal (decided 28 September, audit R214 (1)). Null when none is scheduled.

effectiveFrom.description: Always the `renewsAt` it was scheduled against.

SubscriptionPlanRecommendation.x-ticvai-persistence: none — computed from control.usage_record, the plan, tier and add-on limits and capacity packs, priced as simulateCommercialPackage prices
SubscriptionPlanRecommendation.description: One plan-fit move for a tenant, priced against staying as it is (20.8.4, 20.8.5; decided 29 September, build pass, group G2).

targetPlanId.description: The tier to move to, for `upgrade` and `downgrade`.

billableUnit.description: The unit that drives it (for `upgrade`, `downgrade` and `capacityPack`), as `getLicenceEnforcement` names it.

capacityPackSize.description: For `capacityPack`, the pack size that covers the projected overage.

projectedSaving.description: Against staying as it is over the horizon, monthly. Set where the move saves money.

projectedAddedCost.description: Where the move costs more than today but less than the alternative named in `comparedWith`.

comparedWith.description: What the move is cheaper than. An `upgrade` is compared with paying the projected overage; a `capacityPack` with the next tier.

reason.description: One sentence a person can repeat to the customer.

lastUsedAt.description: For `removeModule` and `removeAddOn`, the last metered use; null for never.

applyWith.description: The operation a person uses to carry it out (after `previewSubscriptionChange` for `setSubscription`).

SuspensionMode.description: Access validation continues under every mode. A commercial dispute must not strand guests at a gate holding valid tickets.

suspensionEffectiveAt.description: When the suspension takes, or took, effect — `suspendTenant.effectiveAt`. **A future value is a pending suspension**: the tenant stays `active` until then, and this row is the only place that says a suspension is coming.

suspensionNoticeMessage.description: The notice shown to the tenant's users about the suspension — `suspendTenant.noticeMessage`.

terminationScheduledAt.description: When `terminateTenant` started the retention window. Null when no termination is under way.

terminationRetentionUntil.description: `terminationScheduledAt` plus the request's `retentionDays`. **Stored, not recomputed** — the day count is client-supplied and exists nowhere else, and this is the date the cells are destroyed after.

planVersion.description: The version of the plan the tenant is on (with `planId`, the key of the plan row; R8 blocker APPROVALS-TENANCY-C15, CHG-R8INT-023). Null when `planId` is.

cellHost.description: The host of the tenant's home cell (the host part of `Cell.apiEndpoint` of the cell that holds the tenant in its home region), derived on read through `control.cell_tenant`. Added for ADM-018 (r8 walk of ticket 27886): the console reaches the cell's grant and language operations at this host without holding `PLATFORM_CELL_VIEW`, which `listTenantCells` needs. Null while the tenant has no cell.

cellHosts.description: One entry per region the tenant is in, for a multi-region tenant; the entry with `isHome` true is `cellHost`. The screen uses the home cell for language and grant operations.

regionId.description: The tenant's home region: the `tenancy` region node whose `RegionSettings` govern tenant-wide gates, today `allowedAiResidencies` (decided 28 September, audit R203). Written by the server when the tenant's first region is created; null until then. ADM-037 reads it to show the region's residency restriction, and `ai.setAiProvider` checks against the same region.

billingAddress.description: Accepted by `createTenant` and `updateTenant`; stored here so the response can return what was sent.

VsiAssessment.description: Board 2 — the ten-screen questionnaire, as data. **In the control database** (ADAM CR-150, 18 October 2026; CHG-CRA-003): a prospect's sign-up answers are about a tenant to be, not inside one. It holds an organisation name and a contact email, so **which control database holds it is ADR-0043's decision** (personal data stays in its region); the lead records it before rows are written.

VsiResult.description: Board 2.10. **A prospect told only their price has been told nothing they can argue with.**
